title: Keybind Manager
description: Allows switching between keybind profiles and binding multiple keys to a single action.
body:
# 🎮 KeybindManager

Take full control of your Minecraft keybinds.

**KeybindManager** lets you create custom keybind profiles, use advanced key combinations, assign multiple keybinds to the same action, and easily switch between different playstyles.

📦 **Fabric API Required**
KeybindManager requires **Fabric API** to run. Make sure it is installed before launching the game.

🔍 **Controlling & Searchables Compatible**
Works seamlessly with the Controlling and Searchables mods.

## ✨ Features

🔄 **Keybind Profiles**
Create different layouts for Crystal PvP, Mace PvP, Building, Survival, Creative, or entire modpacks.

⚡ **Instant Profile Switching**
Switch between complete keybind setups in seconds without manually rebinding everything.

⌨️ **Key Combinations**
Use combinations like **Ctrl + D**, **Alt + F**, **Shift + G**, and more.

🔗 **Multiple Keybinds Per Action**
Assign multiple keys or combinations to a single action.

🚨 **Conflict Detection**
Quickly find and resolve keybind conflicts.

💾 **Save & Restore Layouts**
Never lose your favorite setup again.

📤 **Import & Export Profiles**
Share configurations with friends and communities.


## ❤️ Why KeybindManager?

Different activities often require different controls. For example, your Crystal PvP keybinds may be completely different from your Mace PvP setup. Instead of constantly changing controls manually, KeybindManager allows you to create dedicated profiles and switch between them instantly.

Whether you're a PvP player, builder, speedrunner, or modpack enthusiast, KeybindManager helps keep your controls organized and ready for any situation.
